purpose: Record rights and publisher-dependence evidence for newly acquired official datasets without making a legal-clearance determination.

rows.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
rows.official_policy_observation: The Board states that, unless otherwise indicated, website information is public domain and may be copied and distributed with citation; non-Board photos, graphics, trademarks, and linked materials may require separate permission. SHED interactive visualizations do not replace the official release.
rows.access_basis: official public CSV and codebook release page
rows.upstream_identity: Federal Reserve SHED annual survey and chart-data ZIP
rows.retention_scope: retain source URL, retrieval date, version hash, and normalized values; confirm publisher terms before distributing raw files
rows.next_action: Review Federal Reserve data-page terms and attribution requirements; document whether derived chart publication is permitted.

rows.publisher: U.S. Department of Agriculture Economic Research Service
rows.official_policy_observation: ERS API terms permit services to search, display, analyze, retrieve, and view ERS data and require prominent attribution; the terms govern API content, while this acquisition is an official publication/statistical supplement and therefore retains an exact-publication reuse review. ERS quality standards describe public dissemination and documentation but are not a redistribution license.
rows.access_basis: official publication and statistical supplement route
rows.upstream_identity: USDA ERS CPS Food Security Supplement estimates
rows.retention_scope: retain source URL, retrieval date, page hash, and normalized estimates; confirm report/chart reuse terms before distributing raw tables
rows.next_action: Apply the ERS attribution notice where API content is used, verify whether the publication/statistical supplement has any additional reuse restriction, and document the derived-chart boundary before redistribution.

rows.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
rows.official_policy_observation: The Board's general notice supports attributed copying of Board information unless otherwise indicated, while the official SHED release controls over interactive visualization discrepancies; public-use files, codebooks, and embedded non-Board material remain artifact-specific review items.
rows.access_basis: official SHED chart-data ZIP, public-use CSV, and codebook
rows.upstream_identity: Federal Reserve SHED $400 emergency-expense series and pay_casheqv-derived point estimates
rows.retention_scope: retain chart URL, microdata URL, retrieval dates, version hashes, and normalized values; confirm publisher terms before distributing raw files or derived charts
rows.next_action: Review Federal Reserve data-page terms and attribution requirements for both chart and public-use microdata artifacts; document derived-chart boundaries.

rows.upstream_identity: JPMorganChase Institute household liquidity analysis, December 2023
rows.retention_scope: retain citation, URL, retrieval date, and normalized metadata; do not redistribute report text, figures, or raw material without written permission
rows.next_action: Confirm whether a derived internal comparison is permitted under the report's written-republication notice and record attribution requirements.

rows.official_policy_observation: The official download page identifies the Open Repair Data Standard v0.3 aggregate release and states a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. Attribution and share-alike obligations must travel with derived summaries; the archive checksum and transformation notes remain part of the evidence chain.
rows.upstream_identity: Open Repair Data Standard v0.3 aggregate EEE file, filtered to ORDS product_category=Mobile
rows.retention_scope: retain archive URL, retrieval date, SHA-256, filtered field definition, attribution, and share-alike notice; do not imply that the license makes the sample representative or policy-valid
rows.next_action: Preserve the CC BY-SA attribution/share-alike notice in every frontend export and confirm whether any contributor-specific material or raw-row redistribution condition applies before external redistribution.

rows.official_policy_observation: Census API use is subject to the Bureau's terms and website policies. Census citation guidance says users creating estimates from disseminated tables should cite Census as the original source and that analytical conclusions are the user's responsibility. Census transparency guidance requires methods and use-relevant information to remain documented.
rows.access_basis: official County Business Patterns download/API route
rows.upstream_identity: U.S. Census Bureau County Business Patterns, NAICS repair proxy
rows.retention_scope: retain source URL, retrieval dates, download hashes, suppression flags, and Census citation; do not redistribute raw ZIP files or publish derived charts until exact product terms and rights-owner approval are recorded
rows.next_action: Attach the exact CBP product notice and attribution language to the acquired-source record and document the permitted derived-chart scope.

rows.official_policy_observation: Census API and website terms govern access routes; Census citation guidance requires attribution of original data for user-created estimates, while transparency guidance requires methods and use-relevant limitations to remain visible. Exact Nonemployer Statistics product notices remain controlling.
rows.upstream_identity: U.S. Census Bureau Nonemployer Statistics, NAICS repair proxy
rows.retention_scope: retain source URL, retrieval dates, download hashes, suppression flags, and Census citation; do not redistribute raw files or publish derived charts until exact product terms and rights-owner approval are recorded
rows.next_action: Attach the exact NES product notice and attribution language to the acquired-source record and document the permitted derived-chart scope.

boundary: This register records rights evidence and review tasks for seven official acquisitions. It is not legal advice, permission, fair-use analysis, or a license grant.
